WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
web_v1 AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_agg
),
store_agg AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
store_v1 AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_agg
),
full_join AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(web.item_sk, store.item_sk) AS item_sk,
           COALESCE(web.d_date, store.d_date) AS d_date,
           web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           store.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_v1 web
    LEFT JOIN store_v1 store
      ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk
     AND web.d_date = store.d_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT COALESCE(store.item_sk, web.item_sk) AS item_sk,
           COALESCE(store.d_date, web.d_date) AS d_date,
           web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           store.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM store_v1 store
    LEFT JOIN web_v1 web
      ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk
     AND web.d_date = store.d_date
    WHERE web.item_sk IS NULL
),
joined AS (
    SELECT fj.item_sk,
           fj.d_date,
           fj.web_sales,
           fj.store_sales,
           (SELECT w2.cume_sales
            FROM web_v1 w2
            WHERE w2.item_sk = fj.item_sk
              AND w2.d_date <= fj.d_date
            ORDER BY w2.d_date DESC
            LIMIT 1) AS web_cumulative,
           (SELECT s2.cume_sales
            FROM store_v1 s2
            WHERE s2.item_sk = fj.item_sk
              AND s2.d_date <= fj.d_date
            ORDER BY s2.d_date DESC
            LIMIT 1) AS store_cumulative
    FROM full_join fj
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM joined
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
